jobs.objective: REVISE the banked v2 RFC 0168 P0 SPEC to close the TWO narrow residual holes the v2 cycle-1 adjudicator named, carrying forward UNREGRESSED everything v1 AND v2 cleared. Start from the v2 SPEC at context/v2_HOLDER.md (the required base — this is the v2 holder SPEC, NOT the v1 base); the v2 cycle-1 verdict at context/v2_COLLABORATION_LEDGER_cycle_1.md gives the exact prescribed fixes (its findings OQ2-SCRUB-POSTCONDITION and OQ4-ACL-PROVISIONING-TRANSITION are authoritative). This is a tightening of two predicates, NOT a rewrite. CARRY FORWARD UNREGRESSED (v1+v2 PROVEN/CREDITED, do NOT reopen): the structural hard core HC-A1..A5 (a per-lane uid dissolves the BC1-W1-ORACLE replay wall on this host under Yama ptrace_scope=1 — the claim that unblocks RFC 0143 Slice B's lane-uid-owned 0600 reseal token); the C1 durable 4-state lease machine active/scrubbing/quarantined/returned + partial held-unique index uq_lane_uid_held + allocate/scrub-begin/scrub-finalize 3-transaction boundary + leaked-active and stuck-scrubbing reaper + doctor surface + quarantine-survives-restart + dirty-excluding exhaustion accounting; the C2 final .striatum/-excluding ACL end-state + per-leased-uid traverse-only entry + per-supervisor scratch + chowned worktree + the A16 after-state test; and OQ1/OQ3/OQ5/OQ6 + the narrowing invariant (no admin-token widening, no lane-readable shared reseal bearer, surface only ever removed). DISCHARGE C1-RESIDUAL (OQ2-SCRUB-POSTCONDITION — verdict-driving): the v2 scrub-postcondition proof predicate P1 only blocks return on a uid-owned process in R/S/D and records zombies without blocking, so a uid-owned task left in T (stopped) or t (tracing-stop) — which has NOT exited, still holds the uid, memory, FDs, and HOME/credential reachability, and is SIGCONT-resumable — passes P1 and lets the dirty uid reach `returned` and be re-leased = the exact same-uid cross-lease residue leak 0168 exists to close. This is buildable-critical: the existing processZombie helper (go/pkg/supervisor/tmux_liveness.go:599-614) classifies /proc state as binary Z-or-not, so an implementer wiring P1 off it inherits the leak. The revised SPEC MUST tighten P1 to: zero pool_uid-owned tasks except true zombies/dead tasks that cannot execute and hold no resources — ANY observed non-zombie state (T, t, or unknown) MUST block `returned` and finalize `quarantined` with a typed lane_uid_scrub_failed; record observed PIDs + /proc states in scrub_proof so doctor distinguishes tolerated Z residue from a non-zombie quarantine cause; and add TestStoppedOrTracedUIDProcessBlocksReturn (inject a stopped/traced uid-owned survivor; assert quarantine + non-allocation + restart-preserved quarantine + proof-gated clear). DISCHARGE C2-RESIDUAL (OQ4-ACL-PROVISIONING-TRANSITION — verdict-driving): the v2 SPEC gates only on the auditable end-state and BLESSES `setfacl -R -m g:striatum-lanes:rX <repoRoot>` followed by a strip over .striatum/ — but the first -R necessarily adds group r to existing .striatum/ 0600 control-plane files (the MCP bearer mcpconfig.go:241/266; PTY logs loop.go) BEFORE the strip, so on a live repo .striatum/ is transiently group-readable and a bearer read in that window is irreversible cross-lane exfiltration; the A16 after-state test misses it. The revised SPEC MUST make the allowlist / exclude-at-traversal provisioning form MANDATORY (the group grant NEVER applies g:striatum-lanes:rX or its default to .striatum/, .git/, or provider/token-cache paths, even transiently), explicitly FORBID `setfacl -R ...:rX <repoRoot>`-then-strip as a live-repo path, extend A16 into a transition test TestPoolACLProvisioningNeverTransientlyExposesScratch (an unleased AND a different-leased pool uid attempt open(2)/traversal before/during/after provisioning; no read ever succeeds), and add an ACL-planner guard / unit test that fails if any g:striatum-lanes op targets <repoRoot> as a raw recursive root while .striatum/ exists. Open the SPEC with an auditable 'Addressing the v2 residual constraints' map (C1-RESIDUAL RESOLVED how, C2-RESIDUAL RESOLVED how, all v1+v2 carry-forwards INTACT). The build run should target the next FREE runtime-migration slot (0045 is reserved by the concurrent RFC 0170 P0 cullable_entity work — use 0046+ for lane_uid_leases) and an owner-bundle bump for the daemon-owned striatumd.lane_uid_leases table; do not hardcode 0045. Keep every load-bearing claim a falsifiable assertion + the test/source site that refutes it, anchored to the live tree. This is the published claim the falsifiers re-attack.
